caniuse-lite: CC-BY-4.0 covers the browser-support DATA only, not code; attribution is satisfied by the package's own notice. Build-time, via Vite/Tailwind.
lightningcss*: MPL-2.0 is file-level weak copyleft on ITS files only; lightningcss is a build tool used unmodified by Tailwind v4 and ships nothing into our bundle. Dev-only. The prefix covers its one-native-binary-per-platform packages (darwin-*, linux-*, win32-*), which carry the same licence.
axe-core: MPL-2.0 is file-level weak copyleft on ITS files only; axe-core is the accessibility engine behind the a11y gate (doc 49 §4), run unmodified by @storybook/test-runner against stories in CI. Dev-only; ships nothing into our bundle.
